Class WhoFederatedAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.autoconfigure.WhoFederatedAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after=WhoAutoConfiguration.class) @ConditionalOnClass(name="org.jwcarman.who.federated.JdbcFederatedCredentialRepository") public class WhoFederatedAutoConfiguration extends Object
Registers the (issuer, subject) credential's repository and service when who-federated is on the classpath, which who-jwt brings. It has no off switch of its own: credentials stay readable and removable even when JWT sign-in is turned off.
